newsitem.title: USA: PanAm names chief operating officer.
newsitem.headline: PanAm names chief operating officer.

text.p: Pan American World Airways said Friday it has named James Arpey to the new position of chief operating officer.

Arpey, an airline industry veteran, worked at Continental Airlines and its affiliates between 1972 and 1990, holding various positions, lastly as senior vice president of operations and aircraft programs, PanAm said.
In recent years, Arpey served as an aviation consultant specializing in aircraft and aircraft parts sales, it said.
Arpey will report to Martin Shugrue Jr., president and chief operating officer, PanAm said.
